title: Terms and Conditions
intro: These terms apply when you request, book or use any service from Cherish Concierge ("Cherish", "we", "us"). Please read them before you send a booking request. Nothing in these terms limits any right you have under the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008, the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act 25 of 2002 or the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013.

sections.heading: 1. Our service
paragraphs: Cherish plans and coordinates romantic and celebratory experiences, including proposals, date requests, picnics, scavenger hunts, flower and gift deliveries, graduation surprises and bachelor or bachelorette events, together with any bespoke experience we agree with you in writing.
We arrange the experience using our own team and independent suppliers such as photographers, florists, musicians, caterers, venues and transport providers ("suppliers").

sections.heading: 2. Quote requests and confirmation
paragraphs: Requesting a quote or sending a bespoke brief through our website, WhatsApp or email is a request only. It is not a confirmed booking and no payment is taken on the website.

After we receive your request we will check availability and send you a written quote (by WhatsApp or email) setting out what is included, the total price and the deposit. A quote is valid for 7 days unless it says otherwise.
Your booking is confirmed only once you have accepted the quote, we have received your deposit, and we have confirmed receipt in writing. The price in your accepted quote is the price that applies.

sections.heading: 3. Prices and payment
paragraphs: All prices are in South African Rand (ZAR) and include any taxes that apply to us.

The deposit in your accepted quote is payable by EFT to the bank account we give you in writing. Always confirm banking details with us by phone or WhatsApp before paying. We will never change our banking details by email alone.
The balance is payable on or before the event day, as confirmed in writing. We may decline to start the event if the balance has not been paid.
Any extra items or changes you ask for after confirmation will be quoted and agreed in writing before they are added.

sections.heading: 4. Changes and rescheduling
paragraphs: If you need to move your event, tell us as soon as possible. If you give us at least 7 days' notice, we will move your booking once to a new date within 6 months at no charge, subject to availability. Any supplier costs that cannot be moved will be explained to you before you decide.
Changes with less than 7 days' notice are subject to availability and may carry the reasonable costs that we or our suppliers cannot recover.

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation by you
paragraphs: You may cancel a confirmed booking at any time by telling us in writing. As allowed by section 17 of the Consumer Protection Act, a reasonable cancellation charge applies, based on how much notice you give:
More than 14 days before the event: we refund your deposit, less any supplier costs already paid on your behalf that cannot be recovered, which we will show you.
Between 72 hours and 14 days before the event: the deposit is kept to cover supplier commitments and planning work already done.
Less than 72 hours before the event: the deposit is kept, and you are responsible for any further supplier costs already committed for your event.
If you cancel because of a death, hospitalisation or other medical emergency, contact us. We will take this into account and offer a fair solution.

sections.heading: 6. Cancellation or changes by us
paragraphs: If we have to cancel your event for any reason within our control, we will refund everything you have paid us in full, or, if you prefer, move your event to another date.
If a supplier becomes unavailable, we will replace them with a supplier of a similar standard. If we cannot, we will tell you and adjust the price or refund the affected part.

sections.heading: 7. Weather and events outside anyone's control
paragraphs: For outdoor setups we plan a sheltered backup option with you in advance. If the weather makes the outdoor plan unsafe or impractical, we will decide together to move to the backup option or to reschedule.

If an event cannot go ahead because of circumstances outside our and your reasonable control (for example severe weather warnings, civil unrest, load-shedding that a backup cannot cover, or a venue closure ordered by authorities), we will first offer to reschedule. If rescheduling is not possible, we will refund what you have paid, less supplier costs that cannot be recovered, which we will show you.

sections.heading: 8. Your responsibilities
paragraphs: Please give us accurate information about the date, place, people involved and anything that could affect the event, including allergies, accessibility needs and anything your partner must not find out.
Please arrive at the agreed time. If you are late, we will do our best, but the event may need to be shortened to fit venue or supplier times.

You are responsible for the behaviour of your guests and for any damage they cause to hired items or venues. Alcohol is only served to people aged 18 and older, and suppliers may refuse service to anyone who is intoxicated.
Engagement rings and personal gifts you bring remain your responsibility at all times.

sections.heading: 9. Suppliers and venues
paragraphs: Suppliers are independent businesses and their own terms may also apply. We choose suppliers carefully and coordinate them for you, and we will take reasonable steps to sort out any problem with a supplier on your behalf.

Public places, parks and venues have their own rules. Where a permit or permission is needed, we will tell you and arrange it where we can. Some places may restrict décor, music, open flames or drones.

sections.heading: 10. Plans and scripts
paragraphs: Ideas, plans, timelines and scripts we share with you, including suggestions on our website, are there to help you get started. They are not a confirmed booking and may change once we check availability.
You are welcome to use and change the scripts we give you for your own event.

sections.heading: 11. Photos, video and your privacy
paragraphs: We only collect the personal information we need to plan and run your event, such as your name, phone number, email address, event details and your partner's first name. We store it securely and keep it only for as long as we need it for your booking and our legal records.
We share your information only with the suppliers who need it to deliver your event, and we never sell it.

Photos and videos of your event belong to you. We will only use them on our website or social media if you, and anyone clearly shown in them, agree in writing first. You can withdraw that consent at any time for future use.

You may ask us at any time what information we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it. If you are unhappy with how we handle your information, you may complain to the Information Regulator (inforegulator.org.za).

sections.heading: 12. Our responsibility to you
paragraphs: We will deliver our services with reasonable care and skill, and in the manner and quality that people are generally entitled to expect, as required by the Consumer Protection Act.

To the extent the law allows, our total responsibility for any claim connected with a booking is limited to the amount you paid us for that booking. This does not limit our responsibility for loss caused by our gross negligence or wilful misconduct, or any responsibility that cannot be limited by law.
We are not responsible for an emotional outcome we cannot control, such as your partner's answer.

sections.heading: 13. Complaints
paragraphs: If something is not right, please tell us as soon as possible on WhatsApp or by email so we can try to fix it, ideally on the day. We will respond to written complaints within 5 business days.
If we cannot resolve your complaint, you may contact the Consumer Goods and Services Ombud (cgso.org.za) or the National Consumer Commission.

sections.heading: 14. General
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of South Africa.
We may update these terms from time to time. The version on our website on the date your booking is confirmed applies to that booking.
If any part of these terms is found to be unenforceable, the rest remains in force.
